name: YieldAgentX402

ShadeGuard enforces policy before funds move; x402 settles payments on 18 chains; every governed run returns HMAC-SHA256 receipts with optional Filecoin anchoring. Custody-free NEAR MPC wallets. Sixteen MCP tools via Streamable HTTP; public discovery with yax_get_capabilities (no API key).
